title: NASA mission controller Tim Taylor says astronauts see things

tellings.quote: been outed, his name is Tim Taylor, is a

plain: A NASA mission controller named Timothy Taylor is said to have revealed that astronauts see unexplained things in space. Michels passes this on from a book called American Cosmic, noting that Taylor has since "been outed" by name. If true, it would mean the space agency's own people know of sightings that are not made public.
